```{r 1_1, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
emalgK <- function(dat, K=3, eps=1e-6, tiny=1e-12, maxit=10000, keep_history=TRUE){
  n <- length(dat)
  pik <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=n, ncol=K)

  # initialization
  p     <- rep(1/K, K)
  s0    <- sd(dat) * 2/3
  sigma <- rep(s0, K)
  m0    <- mean(dat)
  mu    <- seq(m0 - s0, m0 + s0, length.out=K)

  loglik <- function(){
    ll <- 0
    for (j in 1:n){
      s <- 0
      for (k in 1:K){
        s <- s + p[k] * dnorm(dat[j], mean=mu[k], sd=sigma[k])
      }
      ll <- ll + log(max(s, tiny))
    }
    ll
  }

  # history
  if (keep_history){
    phist     <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=maxit, ncol=K)
    muhist    <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=maxit, ncol=K)
    sigmahist <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=maxit, ncol=K)
    llhist    <- rep(NA_real_, maxit)
  }

  ll_old <- -Inf
  it <- 0

  repeat {
    it <- it + 1

    ### E step ###
    for (j in 1:n){
      num <- numeric(K)
      for (k in 1:K){
        num[k] <- p[k] * dnorm(dat[j], mean=mu[k], sd=sigma[k])
      }
      den <- sum(num)
      if (!is.finite(den) || den < tiny) den <- tiny
      for (k in 1:K){
        pik[j,k] <- num[k] / den
      }
    }

    ### M step ###
    Nk <- colSums(pik)
    p <- Nk / n
    p <- pmax(p, tiny); p <- p / sum(p)

    for (k in 1:K){
      mu[k] <- sum(pik[,k] * dat) / Nk[k]
      v <- sum(pik[,k] * (dat - mu[k]) * (dat - mu[k])) / Nk[k]
      sigma[k] <- sqrt(max(v, tiny))
    }

    ll_new <- loglik()

    if (keep_history){
      phist[it,]     <- p
      muhist[it,]    <- mu
      sigmahist[it,] <- sigma
      llhist[it]     <- ll_new
    }

    # stopping: relative logLik improvement
    rel_impr <- (ll_new - ll_old) / max(abs(ll_old), 1)
    if (is.finite(rel_impr) && rel_impr < eps) break
    if (it >= maxit) break
    ll_old <- ll_new
  }

  if (!keep_history){
    return(list(p=p, mu=mu, sigma=sigma, it=it, logLik=ll_new))
  }

  phist     <- phist[1:it,, drop=FALSE]
  muhist    <- muhist[1:it,, drop=FALSE]
  sigmahist <- sigmahist[1:it,, drop=FALSE]
  llhist    <- llhist[1:it]

  list(p=p, mu=mu, sigma=sigma, it=it, logLik=ll_new,
       phist=phist, muhist=muhist, sigmahist=sigmahist, llhist=llhist)
}

load("threepops.Rdata")
length(dat3p)

hist(dat3p, breaks=20, col="grey80", main="Histogram of dat3p", xlab="dat3p")

fit <- emalgK(dat3p, K=3, eps=1e-6)
cat("p:     ", paste(fit$p, collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("mu:    ", paste(fit$mu, collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("sigma: ", paste(fit$sigma, collapse=", "), "\n")

par(mfrow=c(3,1), mar=c(4,4,2,1))

matplot(fit$phist, type="l", lty=1, xlab="Iteration", ylab="p_k")
matplot(fit$muhist, type="l", lty=1, xlab="Iteration", ylab="mu_k")
matplot(fit$sigmahist, type="l", lty=1, xlab="Iteration", ylab="sigma_k")

plot(fit$llhist, type="l", xlab="Iteration", ylab="log-likelihood")
```
